description: Learn bounded complex 5-tap correction from received and blind-parent forward features using paired source clean IQ as offline target; no DURA or TX labels.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CPU two threads, CUDA disabled, source-only training

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Fixed approved impaired source IQ and paired source clean IQ; target bounded oracle 5-tap fit to clean-forward signal; features use received and blind-parent forward only.
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX source labels or U_s truth; only clean source IQ and frozen F soft outputs
data.validation_ref: RX4/6 source validation and RX8 source holdout excluded from training; later fixed restoration validation
data.leo_config_ref: Approved simulated impaired source IQ; fixed first non-clean view and no target adaptation

permissions.query_use: Source L_s/U_s paired clean and impaired IQ to create source-only channel target; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or ground test.
permissions.claim_scope: Source channel regressor training only, not restoration or ground accuracy. Source pairs previously explored.

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh zero-output 62-feature regressor, independent frozen blind source action and source Gaussian prior; no DURA or F network.
sources: Fixed independent source blind action checkpoint 94693a342bb2daa684c0f21415d7b949f9fb2107
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same 8192 source fit IDs and source view assignments as independent unroll; disjoint source validation and heldout; source clean paired IQ target only; no DURA.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 8192 fit IDs fixed, source view first non-clean, 30 epochs, final checkpoint; no validation/ground selection.

notes: No DURA or F network in training or channel predictor.
Paired source clean IQ constructs bounded oracle correction as supervision only; inference predictor consumes received and blind-parent output.
Training uses fixed 8192 source fit IDs, one previously approved impaired view each, disjoint validation and heldout.
This is an operator model, not yet a restoration result; predeclare source diagnostics before model results.
